name: Bad Dreams
overview: Scripture reveals that bad dreams can be a source of fear and disturbance, as seen in Pharaoh's and Nebuchadnezzar's troubling dreams that disrupted their peace and sleep. Job acknowledges the terror that dreams and visions can bring, highlighting the spiritual weight they carry. Yet, the Bible also offers comfort through the assurance of God's protection, promising peaceful and sweet sleep to those who trust in the Lord, as expressed in the Psalms and Proverbs.
